title: Next.js 16 warns middleware is deprecated, and proxy.ts throws if you set runtime = 'edge'
symptoms: The "middleware" file convention is deprecated. Please use "proxy" instead.
Build error after renaming to proxy.ts with export const runtime = 'edge' still in the file
Edge-only code paths in middleware now run on Node.js after the rename
cause: Next.js 16 renamed middleware to proxy and fixed the proxy runtime to Node.js with no runtime option. Only the deprecated middleware file can still run on the Edge runtime.
fix: Rename the file and the exported function to proxy, drop the runtime export, and rename config flags like skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize. Stay on middleware.ts if you truly need Edge.
apply:
npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest
# or by hand
mv middleware.ts proxy.ts
# export function proxy(request: NextRequest) { ... }
